name: maplibre-style-tools
description: AI SDK tools for inspecting and editing MapLibre styles.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync('.tmp/tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo', { force: true });"
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run check:mcp-version
scripts.pretest:example:ai-chat: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.tmp/ai-chat-test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test:example:ai-chat: pnpm run build && tsc -p examples/ai-chat/tsconfig.test.json && node --test .tmp/ai-chat-test-dist/src/providers.test.js
scripts.pretest:example:bridge: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.tmp/example-test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build:example:bridge: pnpm run example:typecheck && vite build --config examples/browser-bridge/vite.config.ts
scripts.example:dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run example:typecheck && vite --config examples/browser-bridge/vite.config.ts
scripts.example:build: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:example:bridge
scripts.pretest:e2e:bridge: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['.tmp/playwright-output/browser-bridge', '.tmp/playwright-report/browser-bridge']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test:e2e:bridge: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:example:bridge && pnpm run typecheck:e2e:bridge && playwright test --config examples/browser-bridge/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:mcp-version && pnpm run typecheck:core && pnpm run typecheck:browser && pnpm run typecheck:mcp && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest: pnpm run check:mcp-version && node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.tmp/test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
